text:
Aisha: Morning folks  first day questions: where do I submit badge access, a software license request, and an ergonomic chair form? Also what's the preferred intro format for team channels?
Leo: welcome Aisha! badge -> #people-ops (use the "request badge" workflow) or https://intra.redwood/requests/badge. software licenses -> #engineering and click the "Licenses" shortcut (or ping @infra-bot with `license request`). chair/ergonomics -> #people-ops -> equipment form.
Aisha: thanks! do people usually post the intro in #new-hires or the team channel first?
Priya: post in #new-hires so the onboarding team sees it, then drop a short note in your team channel with who to pair with. intro template: name, role, team, pager/timezone, 1-sentence focus, 1 fun fact. super short is fine.
Aisha: good template. are there channel etiquette rules I should know (thread vs DM, emoji reactions, large files)?
Leo: thread whenever it's related to a thread topic or an alert (helps traceability). DMs ok for 1:1s. avoid posting big logs to channels  use gist or drive links. react with emojis for ack instead of full messages when possible.
Aisha: how about bot noise? I got a bunch of calendar-bot pings. Can I opt out of some bot notif types?
Priya: yes  check channel preferences -> Apps and integrations -> mute specific bot events. calendar-bot has a weekly digest option. don't mute #incidents or the oncall rotation posts.
people-ops: FYI, badge requests are processed within 48 hours. if urgent, mark "expedite" on the form.
infra-bot: License request received: "JetBrains Rider" for Aisha. Ticket #7785.
Aisha: awesome, thanks infra-bot. one last thing: where are the pinned quick links for new hires?
Priya: pinned in #new-hires and also in #devex. quicklinks: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/start, https://intra.redwood/tools/licensing, and the "New Hire Checklist" in Google Drive.
calendar-bot: Welcome Aisha! Your 1:1 calendar invites from your buddy and manager have been sent.
Aisha: all set, everyone was super helpful. excited to be here :tada:
Leo: welcome to the team Aisha  we'll add you to the weekly sync invites. ping if anything blocks you.
Aisha: will do  thanks again!
